Subject: Consolidated reschedule options for missed POC workshop

Hi Samir / Leah,

Sorry we missed you on the original kickoff — we understand schedules get busy. To make the hands-on portion productive, we'd like to offer two consolidated options (shorter but focused) that combine the prompt review, routing checklist, and a brief load-test run so your engineers can see throughput implications: 

• Option A — July 6, 11:00–13:00 PT (americas-friendly window)
• Option B — July 8, 08:00–10:00 PT (earlier window to catch APAC overlap for your India team)

Each slot includes: 20m prompt review + 40m guided workshop (routing + KV/cache walkthrough) + 20m concurrent lightweight load test. We'll bring a pre-configured loadtest-config.yaml and the POC runbook (attached).

If neither works, give us two times that do and we'll consolidate into one invite. Quick asks for you before the session:
- Which ACLs/IP ranges we should expect from your network team?
- Any specific prompts or user flows you want prioritized?

Thanks — I can lock whichever slot works by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198
